name: Strike the myth, type the fact
visual_intent: Open an explainer on a misconception and correct it on screen.

parameters.name: read
parameters.description: Seconds the struck claim stays full size so it can be read

parameters.name: strike
parameters.description: Options for Studio.type.strike (style line or scribble, color via --c-strike)

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Cue map (Studio.cues) or word times (Studio.cues.fromWords); place it on the word or beat it illustrates

code_snippet.javascript:
// lay the correction out below the claim; give it the film's 'right' colour and at least the claim's size
var s = Studio.type.strikeCorrect(tl, '#claim', '#fix', cue('myth'), { read: 0.6 });

fallbacks: Studio.type.typewriter for both lines with a Studio.fx.stamp 'WRONG' on the claim.

performance_characteristics.memory_impact: Low; estimate, not measured on the M2

validation_steps: python scripts/frame-review.py tests/reference-derived/scramble-strike-caption/index.html --serve-root . --fonts google --at <typed, struck, demoted, corrected>
On the render host: hyperframes snapshot at the strike and after the correction

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/backlog-techniques.html in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28.
